Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vikram - 32 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Meenakshi - 27 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Anjali - 60 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
4. Kavita - 34 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez
5. Rajesh - 48 years, general
Look: armour, a sword at the waist, thick moustache

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Vikram stands on the training ground. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vikram practises sword fighting.]

Meenakshi: "Really?"

[Vikram draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Meenakshi: "Vikram, listen!"

[Vikram swings his sword from the saddle of his horse.]

Vikram (gently): "Meenakshi, listen!"

[Vikram shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Meenakshi (softly): "What next?"

[Meenakshi rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Meenakshi: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Vikram stands in the living room. Anjali, Meenakshi and Rajesh stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "Let's begin."

[Vikram pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Meenakshi: "Hey, look at that!"

[Vikram sips red wine.]

Vikram: "Careful!"

[Vikram drinks a beer.]

Rajesh (happily): "That was fun!"

[Vikram staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Anjali: "That was fun!"

[Vikram and Mother clink their glasses.]

Rajesh: "That was such a fun day!"
